title: Normalized chain-level Hom adjunction at the point
statement: In the ordinary point-extension models [def-pod-point-derived-hom-models], suppose the adjunction L left adjoint to sections has the stated explicit formula on generators. For every unbounded R-module complex c and sheaf-module complex I there exists an isomorphism q from sections of Hom_B(Lc,I) to Hom_R(c,sections I), whose degree-j, degree-p component sends h and x to h_p(1 tensor x). This is precisely IsComparison. No flatness, exactness, or injectivity is required.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: A section of a localized sheaf Hom at the final object is uniquely a global module-sheaf morphism: evaluate it on each object over the final object, with inverse restriction of a global morphism. Apply the additive adjunction to each degree component.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: Sections preserve products, since evaluation computes these products sectionwise. The degree-j Hom projection cone therefore gives a bijection with the product of the component module Hom groups. The explicit adjunction makes this bijection R-linear.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J7: Hom complexes and ordinary internal Hom

proof.text: Apply the projection differential formula d_I h minus (-1)^j h d_L and naturality of the adjunction in each component. This proves the degreewise linear bijections commute with differentials, so their inverses define a chain isomorphism. Its formula follows from the explicit adjunction.
